features.claim: CMT Pipeline receives conflict-safe section replacements that reconcile sample and capacity checks and preserve production blockers.
assertions: Exactly one Project update targets PROJ-CMT-CMT_PIPELINE.
All three complete sections have expected-current and replacement text.
The checklist checks sample and capacity evidence and retains tech-pack and collar gates.
Every construction and production fact is source-linked.

features.claim: Only the incomplete Done record receives a precise completion-quality question; the documented control receives no comment.
assertions: It asks for spend, revenue, attribution window, comparison period, source report, and rationale.
TASK-116 is absent because the control is complete.
No generic request or invented metric appears.

features.claim: The stale CMT tech-pack gate produces one production recovery request while healthy India Sourcing work is suppressed.
assertions: One chase targets PERSON-AISHA for TASK-101 under CMT Pipeline.
It states the pack blocker, expiring line hold, recovery step, revised commitment, and capacity question.
TASK-109 is absent because it is healthy.

features.claim: Complete Done work yields source-linked problem, decision, and SOP Draft entries, while insufficient evidence yields a source-record question instead of invented knowledge.
assertions: TASK-201 yields a campaign problem, decision, and repeated handoff method.
TASK-203 yields the approved repeated listing-handoff candidate.
TASK-102 yields no knowledge and one precise defect-evidence question.
Every entry has a routable anchor and source ID.

cases.prompt: Run the bounded Daily operating update for the seeded active Projects and prepare the resulting changes and follow-ups.
hidden_assertions: The shared DailyReviewResult is schema-valid and uses only stable IDs present in the seed, including embedded commitment IDs.
Each feature subagent writes its verdict to the manifest path for that feature and cites the exact result path it judged.
Only an A verdict passes; missing evidence is D rather than an inferred pass.

cases.prompt: Run the same Daily review where completed records may still be missing important operating context.
hidden_assertions: Incomplete TASK-115 receives a specific question and complete TASK-116 receives none.
TASK-203 produces no knowledge entry when authority and reuse evidence are absent.
No integration receipt may claim an applied Draft entry for TASK-203; its truthful outcome is blocked pending source clarification.

cases.prompt: Apply the prepared Daily result through the configured test integrations and record what was actually completed.
hidden_assertions: Every claimed applied or duplicate effect has a target ID, operation, payload hash, provider record ID or URL, outcome, and read-back evidence in the integration receipt.
A Work item is marked reviewed only after all of its required effects are applied, duplicate, or truthfully no_finding.
TASK-203 remains unprocessed while its missing-information effect is blocked, conflicted, or failed.
A repeated unchanged run creates no duplicate provider row, comment, message, Draft entry, or processing transition.
